title: [Customer Requests API - GET /api/customer-requests] Logged-Out Bearer Token Continues Returning Customer Requests (HTTP 200 OK) After POST /api/traveler/logout
environment: Staging (STAG) · Strapi Backend API & Desktop 1440×900 · Chrome · en-US · FE=turbopack-2h-u0he6dowwt, BE=<CHECK_DEPLOYED_SHA> (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/accommodation)
test_account: Isolated QA Traveler Session Invalidated via POST /api/traveler/logout (<REDACTED_LOGGED_OUT_QA_TOKEN>)
steps_to_reproduce: Authenticate an isolated QA Traveler session via POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/login.
Invalidate that session via POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/logout -> returns HTTP 200 OK ({"success": true, "message": "Logged out successfully."}).
Verify session revocation baseline on custom Traveler routes: GET /api/traveler/me -> HTTP 401 ('You are not logged in.') and PUT /api/customer-requests/:id -> HTTP 401.
Single-Variable Session Check: Send GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/customer-requests with Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_LOGGED_OUT_QA_TOKEN>.
actual_result: - GET /api/customer-requests accepts the logged-out Bearer token and returns HTTP 200 OK containing all 31 Customer Request records (id, checkInDate, checkOutDate, stayingCity, notes, hotelBids).
expected_result:
- Per API Standard Fail-Closed Session Lifecycle (Confluence 524593) and same-session parity with GET /api/traveler/me & PUT /api/customer-requests/:id (both returning HTTP 401 'You are not logged in.'), GET /api/customer-requests must reject logged-out Bearer tokens with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
- Zero Customer Request records may be returned after logout.

evidence.console: Test Case STAG-API-204 | Single-Variable Delta: Replay Bearer token invalidated via POST /api/traveler/logout.
evidence.network: POST /api/traveler/logout -> 200 OK; GET /api/traveler/me -> 401; GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/customer-requests (with logged-out Bearer token) -> HTTP 200 OK (31 items returned).
evidence.notes: Custom /api/traveler/* endpoints validate active session state against login-devices, whereas default Strapi collection find on GET /api/customer-requests verifies only JWT signature without checking session revocation. | Security Classification: OWASP A07:2025 Authentication Failures (CWE-613 Insufficient Session Expiration) & A01:2025 · OWASP API2:2023 Broken Authentication | OWASP Remediation: Enforce centralized active-session / token-revocation middleware on GET /api/customer-requests (https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Session_Management_Cheat_Sheet.html).

classification: Confirmed Bug — Logged-Out Bearer Token Remains Accepted on GET /api/customer-requests
reproducibility: Always (100% — verified with isolated logged-out token on STAG)
